items.title: Pete Candoli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: Chet Baker, that had been inducted.

ctx.x: What’s your playing routine these days?

Well Conte and I have been doing very well together as The Brothers, in fact we’ve got a CD coming out and we were both fortunate to be inducted in the National Jazz Hall of Fame which was nice, with some good company. Nat Cole’s wife was there posthumously picking up a trophy for him and a lot of people, Chet Baker, that had been inducted. And that’s done a lot for us as The Brothers – we’re finally coming out with, we’ve done it already, it will be released by Hindsight Records, they just released an album done…
You seem to have played right through the rock & roll revolution, intact.
